title: Epic Scored Jamaican Plum Tomatoes Gratin
description: A rich, snappy Jamaican dish featuring plum tomatoes, served solo for dinner. Perfect as a dairy-free-friendly option.

ingredients.name: score-fat (such as coconut oil or avocado oil)
all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use gluten-free flour for a dairy-free option

instructions: Score the plum tomatoes and set them aside.
In a blender or food processor, combine the flour, curry powder, onion, garlic, and cilantro. Blend until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the coconut oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the plum tomatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the mixture to the steamer basket and steam for 10 minutes.
Transfer the steamer basket to the oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the tomatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Sprinkle the vegan mozzarella shreds over the top of the tomatoes and return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes, or until melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Epic Scored Jamaican Plum Tomatoes Gratin hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
